evidence.excerpt: We present DrivingBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark where general-purpose vision-language models must drive a real car.

evidence.excerpt: The car may continue moving while the model thinks and new commands replace the currently running one, so inference latency is part of the task, testing the models' abilities to observe, act, monitor, recover, and complete a long-horizon objective under such constraints.
